title: Sindh Assembly Members Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 2009

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Assembly Members Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 2009
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT XXXIV OF 2013
ACT XXXIV OF 2013.
SINDH ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND
ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2009
An Act to amend the Sindh
Assembly Members
(Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
1st April, 2013]
No.PAS/Legis-B-04/2009,
dated 1-4-2013.---The Sindh Assembly Members
(Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th March, 2013 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 28th March,
2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and Commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and
Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 2009.
(2) It
shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and
from 1st July, 2011.
